name: flop-closecall-runtime
description: Runtime dependencies of the Close Call service ONLY (/opt/flop-closecall, Node 24.21.0). Kept apart from the repo's package.json, which Node 20.15 workers share: better-sqlite3 13 (N-API) is required on Node >= 24.19, where 11.x/12.x abort in Statement::~Statement during GC, and it needs Node >= 22.
